metadata.name: The Binding Of Isaac - Ascention
metadata.description:
Requires Repentance+, REPENTOGON and Windows.
IMPORTANT: Workshop cannot distribute the required native module.
Download Ascention Native Setup from https://github.com/WhiteRave-Official/the_binding_of_isaac_ascention/releases and run it after subscribing.
What this mod do?
Its a content mod, that's in development. Right now the mod adds:
7 items.
1 trinket.
1 playable character.
